rtl8188eu variant of the generic config: R8188EU=y instead of unset, which brings WIRELESS_EXT back; identical otherwise

symbols.reason: no Kconfig in buildroot, firmware or here, so kconfig ignores the line. Set by the four *_apfpv_greg-generic-* devices, which suggests a package that was never landed. Left in place deliberately: removing it is a maintainer's call about those devices, not a side effect of adding this check.

only devices/apfpv needs it: its own etc/init.d/S99msposd pipes majestic's config.json through jsonfilter, and those two devices do not enable wifibroadcast-ng, which carries the select for every other FPV device. See builder#128, which removed it from the 95 defconfigs that did not.
no Kconfig anywhere; set in devices/common beside BR2_PACKAGE_WIFIBROADCAST_NG, which does exist. Probably a rename that left this behind. Same reasoning as APFPV_GREG.
